resources.string: Rest between sets, in the notification shade. The lock screen shows it only when notifications are allowed there.

SuperOpenGym reads from Health Connect, only with your permission:

• Steps per day, to show your daily activity and compare it with your weight trend.
• Exercise sessions recorded by other apps or your watch (running, walking, bike…), to count your cardio.
• Weight and body fat from a smart scale, added as weigh-ins and body-fat readings.

It writes to Health Connect the workouts you finish in SuperOpenGym, as strength-training sessions.

The data stays on your phone and, if you connect the app to your own server, on that server. It is never sent to anyone else, never sold and not used for advertising.

You can withdraw any permission at any time in Settings → Health Connect.
